typedAutomationActions.name: library.footprint.export_svg

inputs: layers optional — Comma separated list of untranslated layer names to include such as F.Cu,B.Cu
defineVar[] optional — Overrides or adds project variables, can be used multiple times to declare multiple var...
theme optional — Color theme to use (will default to footprint editor settings)
footprint optional — Specific footprint to export within the library
sketchPadsOnFabLayers (bool) optional — Draw pad outlines on front and back fab layers

hideDNPFootprintsOnFabLayers (bool) optional — Don't plot text & graphics of DNP footprints on fab layers
sketchDNPFootprintsOnFabLayers (bool) optional — Plot graphics of DNP footprints in sketch mode on fab layers
crossoutDNPFootprintsOnFabLayers (bool) optional — Plot an 'X' over the courtyard of DNP footprints on fab layers, and strikeout their ref...

typedAutomationActions.name: gerber.convert_png
typedAutomationActions.description: Convert a Gerber or Excellon file to PNG image (kicad-cli gerber convert png; options are validated against its help).
inputs: width optional — Output width in pixels (overrides DPI)
height optional — Output height in pixels (overrides DPI)
strict (bool) optional — Fail on any parse warnings or errors
units optional — Units for viewport parameters, options: mm, inch, mils (default: mm)
windowWidth optional — Viewport width (enables viewport mode)
windowHeight optional — Viewport height (enables viewport mode)
foreground optional — Foreground color as hex (e.g., '#FFFFFF')
background optional — Background color as hex (e.g., '#000000')

typedAutomationActions.name: gerber.diff
typedAutomationActions.description: Compare two Gerber or Excellon files and show differences (kicad-cli gerber diff; options are validated against its help).
inputs: format optional — Output format: png, text, or json (default: png)
dpi optional — Resolution in DPI for PNG output (default: 300)
noAntialias (bool) optional — Disable anti-aliasing for PNG output
transparent (bool) optional — Use transparent background for PNG output
exitCodeOnly (bool) optional — Only set exit code (0=identical, 1=different), no output
tolerance optional — Tolerance in nm for floating point comparisons (default: 0)
strict (bool) optional — Fail on any parse warnings or errors
noAlign (bool) optional — Skip bounding-box origin alignment; catches absolute-placement regressions

typedAutomationActions.name: gerber.info

inputs: format optional — Output format: json, text, png, or svg (default: json)
output (or outputDir) optional — Output file path; required for png/svg, otherwise prints to stdout if omitted
exitCodeOnly (bool) optional — Only set exit code (0=identical, 5=differences found, non-zero on error), no output

typedAutomationActions.name: library.symbol.export_svg
typedAutomationActions.description: Exports the symbol or entire symbol library to SVG (kicad-cli sym export svg; options are validated against its help).
inputs: theme optional — Color theme to use (will default to symbol editor settings)
symbol optional — Specific symbol to export within the library
blackAndWhite (bool) optional — Black and white only

typedAutomationActions.name: library.symbol.upgrade
typedAutomationActions.description: Upgrades the symbol library to the current kicad version format (kicad-cli sym upgrade; options are validated against its help).
inputs: output (or outputDir) optional — Output file or directory
force (bool) optional — Forces the symbol library to be resaved regardless of versioning

typedAutomationActions.name: board.layers.type.get
typedAutomationActions.description: Read copper layer types (signal/power/mixed/jumper) from the open board (live) or the saved file.
inputs: document (board path; must be open in KiCad for IPC steps)

typedAutomationActions.name: board.layers.type.set
typedAutomationActions.description: Set copper layer types persistently (e.g. In1.Cu/In2.Cu = power). Rewrites the board's layer table, reloads the open board and verifies the types by reading them back from KiCad. Unsaved edits require saveFirst=true.
inputs: document (board path; must be open in KiCad for IPC steps)

typedAutomationActions.name: board.via.create
typedAutomationActions.description: Create vias (through/blind/buried/micro) at positions or in the pads of a footprint (via-in-pad), with drill/diameter and IPC-4761 filled/capped/plugged/covered settings; every via is read back and checked.
inputs: document (board path; must be open in KiCad for IPC steps)

typedAutomationActions.name: board.via.modify
typedAutomationActions.description: Batch-modify existing vias selected by ids[], nets[] or all=true: drill, diameter, type, layer span and filled/capped/plugged/covered; read back and verified.
inputs: document (board path; must be open in KiCad for IPC steps)

typedAutomationActions.name: board.plane.build
typedAutomationActions.description: Build a verified plane for ANY net: create a net-bound zone on the given layers, fill it, require real filled copper on every layer, no unconnected pads/vias and a zone-aware connectivity proof; optionally mark the inner layers as power. An unverified plane is removed (keepOnFailure=false) so no fake pour remains.
inputs: document (board path; must be open in KiCad for IPC steps)

typedAutomationActions.name: board.rule_area.create
typedAutomationActions.description: Create a named rule area (keepout and/or region for custom rules such as T1/T2) from outline points, a box, or a footprint's bounding box/pads plus margin; read back to verify name, layers and keepout flags.
inputs: document (board path; must be open in KiCad for IPC steps)

typedAutomationActions.name: board.keepout.antenna
typedAutomationActions.description: Create an antenna keepout (no tracks, vias or copper on all copper layers) around ANY footprint reference or its antenna pads, e.g. U21 (AP6212) — not limited to a module name whitelist.
inputs: document (board path; must be open in KiCad for IPC steps)

typedAutomationActions.name: board.rules.region.set
typedAutomationActions.description: Write named custom DRC rules scoped to a rule area (A.insideArea('T1')): clearance, track width, via diameter, hole size, annular width, hole clearance, or raw rules[]; same-name rules are replaced, then read back.
inputs: document (board path; must be open in KiCad for IPC steps)

typedAutomationActions.name: board.footprint.place
typedAutomationActions.description: Place a library footprint (libId 'Lib:Name' or a .kicad_mod file) at a position/angle/side: pads, outlines and fields are translated and created through the API, then read back (pad count, reference, side). Unsupported elements are listed, not dropped silently.
inputs: document (board path; must be open in KiCad for IPC steps)

typedAutomationActions.name: board.fiducial.add
typedAutomationActions.description: Add global fiducials (3 asymmetric corners by default) inside the board outline, clear of existing footprints, from Fiducial:Fiducial_1mm_Mask2mm or another library footprint; read back.
inputs: document (board path; must be open in KiCad for IPC steps)

typedAutomationActions.name: board.decap.check
typedAutomationActions.description: Check that every IC power pin has a decoupling capacitor on the same net within maxDistanceMm (power pins by pin type or power-like net name; ground excluded).
inputs: document (board path; must be open in KiCad for IPC steps)

typedAutomationActions.name: board.decap.place
typedAutomationActions.description: Move the nearest free capacitor on each failing power net next to its pin (dry-run by default). Applied moves are read back and checked with live DRC; if violations rise, all moves are reverted.
inputs: document (board path; must be open in KiCad for IPC steps)

typedAutomationActions.name: board.drc.live
typedAutomationActions.description: Native KiCad DRC of the OPEN board including unsaved edits (KiCad saves a temporary copy with its project rules; kicad-cli checks it). Configurable timeoutMs; the same as board.drc.run with document instead of input.
inputs: document (board path; must be open in KiCad for IPC steps)

typedAutomationActions.name: schematic.erc.live
typedAutomationActions.description: Native ERC of the OPEN schematic including unsaved edits (via a temporary copy).

typedAutomationActions.name: board.check.unified
typedAutomationActions.description: One report from native DRC (sign-off count) plus DFM, zone-aware connectivity, decoupling distance, fiducial presence and antenna keepout checks, each finding tagged with its source so counts are never mixed; optionally adds non-DRC findings as KiCad DRC markers. Never claims fabrication readiness (use audit.run).

typedAutomationActions.name: board.dfm.full
typedAutomationActions.description: Full DFM pass: narrow tracks, off-45° and zero-length segments, dangling track stubs, acute junctions and wrongly mirrored silk text. fix=true widens tracks, removes stubs (restored if connectivity gets worse) and corrects silk mirroring, then re-analyzes.
inputs: document (board path; must be open in KiCad for IPC steps)

typedAutomationActions.name: board.route.length_match
typedAutomationActions.description: Length-match a group of nets: measure, choose the target (targetMm or the longest), serpentine-tune the short nets and re-measure; passes only if every net is within toleranceMm. Dry-run unless apply=true.
inputs: document (board path; must be open in KiCad for IPC steps)
